connector.name: NeuroRank
connector.registryDescription: Esports cognitive-combine data over MCP: free cohort stats, paid player & team scouting reports.
connector.summary: Hosted at neurorank.app over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.neurorank, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: API key for the paid tools (get_player_report, get_team_report). Omit it to use the free anonymous tool get_cohort_stats. Create a key at https://neurorank.app/account (Billing > API access); requires an active scout or team subscription.
